parsed.english: The Lebesgue measure of S in ℝⁿ, read as a real number, is at most (n+1)^n / n!.
parsed.why_clearer: It unfolds the bespoke `normalizedVolume` into the plain Lebesgue measure `(volume S).toReal`, so the bound reads directly as a volume bound.
